# Mazen EL-Gayar — Senior Software Engineer & Independent Game Developer

> Mazen EL-Gayar is a senior software engineer and independent game developer based in Port Said, Egypt. He has 4+ years of experience building production-ready cross-platform products with Flutter and Dart, backend APIs with NestJS and Node.js, and independently published games with Unreal Engine 5. He works part-time as a Senior Software Engineer at DoctorVoice and founded MazenX, an independent game studio. He has delivered 20+ live projects, mentored 12+ interns and graduates, and contributed open-source packages to the Flutter ecosystem on pub.dev.

## Professional focus

- **Flutter & Dart**: Cross-platform mobile, web, desktop (Android, iOS, Web, Windows) development
- **NestJS & Node.js**: Backend services, REST APIs, server-side architecture
- **Software architecture**: Clean Architecture, OOP, design patterns, dependency injection, CI/CD, code review, Agile/Scrum
- **Unreal Engine 5**: Blueprints, C++, gameplay systems, movement, combat, enemy AI, level design
- **Technical leadership**: Team coordination across QC, AI, backend, frontend, mobile, and data-analysis teams; mentored 12+ early-career developers (5+ DoctorVoice interns, 7+ RASID graduates)

## Experience

- **DoctorVoice** — Senior Software Engineer, part-time (May 2024–present). Builds Flutter products and NestJS APIs; coordinates cross-functional teams; mentors interns.
- **MazenX Studio** — Founder & Independent Game Developer (July 2026–present). Creates and publishes original Unreal Engine games for Android and Windows.
- **FlexoNexus** — Senior Flutter Developer, full-time (January–March 2026). Multi-tenant ERP platform with four branded Flutter app flavors.
- **Grwan LLC / Global Lean Industry** — Flutter Developer / Project Manager, full-time (March–December 2025). Led development of the LeanGo application family for workforce operations.
- **RASID** — Flutter Developer Lead & Mentor, full-time (April 2024–March 2025). Led delivery of RASID apps; mentored 7+ fresh graduates.

- **LeanGo** — Flutter operations family at GLI (GRWAN Group). Eye (security), FTE (employee operations), FM (facility management), CIL (machine quality dashboards). Modular, role-based, white-label suite. [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/developer?id=GRWAN+GROUP+FZE) · [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/developer/grwan-group-fze/id1619845290)
